verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's own `init` command writes the same SKILL.md skill folder into both Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills) locations, so its skill files work in more than one vendor's harness. The docs never claim conformance to the open Agent Skills specification, and no frontmatter or validation is shown. Missing for 10: explicit statement of Agent Skills spec conformance, evidence of SKILL.md frontmatter/structure, validation against the spec, independent corroboration beyond the two named harnesses.

support.subject: As a developer, skills follow the open Agent Skills specification so the same skill folder is valid beyond this one vendor's tooling

citations.quote: The CLI can add Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code.
The second writes the selected skill files.
